Contract EvaluateLoanRequestModule::addLoanTerm(termid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		loanTerm: LoanTerm = LoanTerm.allInstance()->any(o|o.ItemID = termid),
		currentLoanRequest: LoanRequest = CurrentLoanRequest,
		loanTerms: Set(LoanTerm) = CurrentLoanRequests->select(o|o.RequestID = currentLoanRequest.RequestID)
	precondition:
		currentLoanRequest.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		loanTerm.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		loanTerms.isEmpty() = false
	postcondition:
		currentLoanRequest.AttachedLoanTerms->includes(loanTerm) and
		result = true
}
